results.title: “The future of Ghana football will not be secured by chance” – GFA president Kurt Okraku
results.description: Ghana Football Association (GFA) President Kurt Okraku has stressed that the future of Ghana football will depend on deliberate investment, sound policies and a sustained commitment to youth development.Speaking at the GFA’s 32nd Ordinary Congress at the Ghanaman Soccer Centre of Excellence in Prampram on Thursday, Okraku stressed Ghana cannot rely on chance to maintain its rich football tradition, insisting that the country must put in place deliberate measures to identify, nurture and develop the next generation of football talents.“The future of Ghana football will not be secured by chance - it will be built through deliberate investment, sound policy and unwavering commitment,” Okraku said.“That is why today, I am proud to reaffirm our flagship national youth development policy, Power to the Youth,” he added.The policy reflects the GFA’s focus on placing young players at the centre of Ghana’s long-term football development plans.Ghana has a long history of producing talented footballers who have gone on to make significant contributions at both domestic and international levels. However, the GFA president insists that maintaining that tradition requires a structured approach to youth development rather than relying solely on the emergence of exceptional talents.For Okraku, deliberate investment...
